kind_of_thing.quote: Euoplocephalus ( yoo-OP-loh-SEF-ə-ləs) is a genus of large herbivorous ankylosaurid dinosaurs, living during the Late Cretaceous of Canada.

dinosaur_academic.quote: Euoplocephalus ( yoo-OP-loh-SEF-ə-ləs) is a genus of large herbivorous ankylosaurid dinosaurs, living during the Late Cretaceous of Canada.

kind_of_dinosaur.quote: Its head had a short drooping snout with a horny beak to bite off plants that were digested in the large gut.

dinosaur_group.quote: Like other ankylosaurids, Euoplocephalus was largely covered by bony armor plates, among them rows of large high-ridged oval scutes.
